title: Collection of Tithes and Offerings for the House of the Lord
description: At Hezekiah's command, the Israelites gave generously of their firstfruits: grain, wine, oil, and honey, as well as tithes from their herds and flocks. The offerings were piled in heap after heap from the third month until the seventh. When Hezekiah and the leaders saw the heaps, they praised the Lord. The high priest Azariah reported that since the gifts began to arrive, the people had eaten their fill and still had plenty left over. Then Hezekiah gave orders to prepare storehouses in the house of the Lord.
